description: This file defines the NotesProvider class which manages a list of notes, interacts with the database helper for CRUD operations, and provides filtering and state notification functionalities for a Flutter app.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages notes data, provides methods to load, filter, add, update, delete notes, and notifies listeners of state changes.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously loads notes from the database and updates the internal list, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: filteredNotes
methods.description: Returns a filtered and sorted list of notes based on search query, category, and sorting order.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database, reloads the notes list, and returns the new note ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database and reloads the notes list.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID from the database and reloads the notes list.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID from the current list, returns null if not found.
